chunks: When you said to him who had been favoured by God and was favoured by you: 'Keep your wife to yourself and fear God,' you were hiding something God was about to bring to light, for you had fear of men, though you should fear God more. And when Zaid was through with her, We gave her to you in marriage, so that it may not remain a sin for the faithful to marry the wives of their adopted sons when they are through with them. God's command is to be fulfilled.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the marriage of Zaynab bint Jahus to Prophet Muhammad in Islamic jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the transition from pre-Islamic adoption customs to the Islamic principle that adopted sons are not biological heirs, a truth the Prophet (SAW) initially concealed out of social modesty before divine revelation made it public. It serves as a legal precedent for the marriage of the Prophet to the divorced wife of his adopted son, removing the stigma of 'sonship' and establishing the finality of the divorce. The incident underscores the theme of divine authority superseding human social norms, particularly regarding marital prohibitions.
